What is the cheapest live TV streaming s: The cheapest live TV streaming services in 2026 are Philo (around $28/month) for entertainment, and Sling TV (from about $46/month) if you want sports and news. DirecTV Stream and YouTube TV sit at the higher end near $83–$90/month. For most people balancing price and channel selection, Sling TV offers the lowest entry point with major channels.
How can I watch ESPN without a cable sub: To watch ESPN without cable, your main options are YouTube TV, Hulu + Live TV, Fubo, and DirecTV Stream, all of which carry ESPN in their base packages. ESPN+ is a separate streaming service for additional content. These services generally cost $80 or more per month.
What are the best YouTube TV alternative: The best YouTube TV alternatives include Hulu + Live TV, Fubo, DirecTV Stream, and Philo. Each has trade-offs: Fubo leans into sports, Philo is the budget pick without sports, and DirecTV Stream offers regional sports networks. Hulu + Live TV bundles Disney+ and ESPN+.
Which streaming service has the most fle: Sling TV generally offers the most customizable live TV plans. With Sling, you can subscribe to Orange, Blue, or both, and bolt on themed Extras packages. That modularity is rare — most competitors like YouTube TV and Hulu + Live TV sell a single large bundle.
What live TV streaming services offer no: Nearly all live TV streaming services are no-contract today. YouTube TV, Hulu + Live TV, Fubo, DirecTV Stream, and Philo all let you pause or cancel monthly. There are no early-termination fees, which is a major advantage over traditional cable.
How much does Sling TV cost per month?: Sling TV pricing starts at $40/month for Sling Orange or Sling Blue individually, and the combined plan runs higher. Sling frequently runs promotions for the first month. There's also a free ad-supported option. Exact prices can change, so check Sling's site for current rates.
What channels does Sling TV include?: Sling TV offers two base lineups: Sling Orange (sports and family, including ESPN and Disney Channel) and Sling Blue (news and entertainment, including Fox and MSNBC). Combined you get around 200 channels. Additional packs cover sports, kids, news, and international programming.
Is Sling TV available on Roku?: Yes — Sling TV has a dedicated app on Roku and works across Roku players and Roku TVs. It's also available on Amazon Fire TV, Apple TV, Google TV/Android TV, mobile devices, and the web.
What is Sling Freestream?: Freestream is a free, ad-supported streaming service from Sling TV. It gives you hundreds of live channels and on-demand content without a subscription. It competes with services like Pluto TV, Tubi, and The Roku Channel.
Compare Sling TV vs YouTube TV: YouTube TV and Sling TV differ mainly in scope and price. YouTube TV provides 100+ channels, full local broadcast networks, and unlimited DVR for about $83/month. Sling TV is cheaper and more flexible but offers fewer channels and limited locals. YouTube TV is the better all-in-one choice for most households, while Sling appeals to budget and niche viewers.
